bands.label: Six-country sanctions wave
bands.summary: Norway, Canada, the UK, and partners roll out fresh sanctions on settlers and outposts while a London property event and the Jenin base plan draw parliamentary and EU pushback.

bands.label: First Western sanctions
bands.summary: The US, UK, EU, and Canada open targeted sanctions on individual settlers and outposts as settler violence and Bedouin displacement keep rising across Area C.

bands.label: Post-Oct 7 settler surge
bands.summary: After the Gaza war begins, UN and rights groups record a sharp rise in settler attacks, herder community displacement, and home demolitions across the West Bank.

bands.label: Oslo II and outpost growth
bands.summary: Under the Area A/B/C split, authorized settlements expand and unauthorized outposts spread across Area C while successive Israeli governments regularize many of them.

bands.label: Occupation and early settlement
bands.summary: Israeli military rule over the West Bank begins after the 1967 war and the first generation of civilian settlements and bypass roads is built before the Oslo framework.

frames.label: 2026 six-country sanctions wave
frames.note: The story begins with the coordinated 2026 sanctions packages from Norway, Canada, and partners targeting named settlers and outposts, alongside the London property-event flashpoint. Under this frame the record reads as a Western policy turn against specific networks, with prior decades as background. This is the frame Western foreign ministries and sanctions-tracking outlets open with.

frames.label: Oct 2023 post-attack surge
frames.note: The story begins with the sharp rise in settler attacks and Bedouin displacement after the Oct 2023 Gaza war started. Under this frame the record reads as a wartime acceleration of pre-existing settler activity, framing sanctions as a response to a recent spike. This is the frame UN OCHA reporting, EU diplomats, and many mainstream outlets open with.

frames.label: 1995 Oslo II Area A/B/C
frames.note: The story begins with the Oslo II accords carving the West Bank into Areas A, B, and C and the settler-outpost expansion that followed inside Area C. Under this frame the record reads as a long erosion of a signed framework, with the Jenin base plan and outpost legalization as the latest steps. This is the frame Palestinian negotiators, legal scholars, and Haaretz-style Israeli reporting open with.

frames.label: 1967 occupation begins
frames.note: The story begins with the 1967 war and the start of Israeli military rule over the West Bank, with civilian settlement following soon after. Under this frame the record reads as one continuous displacement process that sanctions only graze at the edges. This is the frame Palestinian civil society, Amnesty, and much of the Global South press open with.
